name: nmasi/era5
description:
ERA5
	

Based on Hersbach et al. 2020 with data exposed through Copernicus C3S API
26 variable subset of data as described in Table 3 of Bonev et al. 2023. Each file contains all 26 variables sampled every 6 hours (starting with 00:00:00) for an entire month in a given year.
